en: A black‑and‑white photographic postcard depicting a large European town square bordered by multi‑story historic buildings with steep tiled roofs and many awnings. In the center stands an ornate multi‑tiered fountain monument with statues and steps, around which small market stalls with umbrellas are set up. In the background a steep hill rises behind the town, crowned by massive fortification walls and a distinctive clock tower on top.
